data.name: Quantum Covenant
data.detailed_description:
HIGH-OCTANE COMBAT - MOVE OR DIE
Enter the arena with your favorite choice of advanced antigravity ships, each with its own stats and unique abilities, and use your abilities to slay hordes of elite enemies and bosses in diverse and varied landscapes across the galaxy. Overwhelm your enemies with lasers, beams, rockets, and artillery. Stay alive using your ship's powerful movement abilities - stillness is death.

WHY WISHLIST?

Built from the ground up on our own proprietary Martyr Engine™, Quantum Covenant is a game that feels like no other game. Experience entirely novel 3D physics based, fast paced action that is unlike any other game you've played.

The Martyr Games Team believes that, before ANYTHING else, games should be FUN. By wishlisting now, you are joining our mission of developing fun games that respect gamers' time and money.

Add to your Wishlist now and join our Discord to contribute to shaping the game: 

STACK UPGRADES - CUSTOMIZE YOUR BUILD - BEND SPACE AND TIME

Every run is different. Choose from an array of weapons, upgrade them and your ship through various fun upgrades and powerful PROTOCOLS that adapt to your playstyle and change the rules of the battlefield. The more waves you survive, the more powerful you become, and the more challenging the enemies get. Choose wisely.

CUSTOM BUILT GAME ENGINE

At the start of development, we were tired of games that felt and looked the same from popular game engines. So we built our own Martyr Engine. Quantum Covenant features realistic physics and gravity mechanics that puts you in the pilot seat of an antigravity ship. Use your speed and unique ability to glide over any kind of terrain to survive waves of enemies in a variety of diverse arena biomes in this sci-fi action roguelike.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS - SUMMON THE SQUAD

Play alone or with run with up to three friends. Combine your ship abilities and builds to discover ridiculous synergies and unleash doom upon your foes in ways that shouldn't be possible. There's strength in numbers, but more friends also bring more foes.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR CRAFT - SHOW US WHO YOU ARE

Customize your favorite ships with unlockable cosmetic upgrades and skins. Show everyone your true colors!

data.short_description: Blast your way through waves of elite enemies and bosses in this high-octane co-op roguelike where movement is your greatest weapon. Pick from an array of hovercraft, customize your build, stack upgrades and become an unstoppable force. Can you survive the Quantum Covenant?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: i5-4460 / Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 Ti / RX 560 (OpenGL 3.3 support)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: i5-8400 / Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2060 / RX 5600 XT (OpenGL 3.3 support)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
